name: ftrlabs-testerbeheer
summary: Maculis Testerbeheer / Invitation Manager + Communication Layer (relationship-oriented, omnichannel, AI-first, human-approved outbound).

qualityGate.deployableSignal: run `node scripts/quality-gate.mjs --require-db --json` and require `.deployable === true`; a non-zero exit code blocks deploy.

coverageLevels.offline: no DATABASE_URL — pure/unit chains run, DB chains skip; NOT sufficient for a deploy decision
coverageLevels.full: DATABASE_URL + COMM_LAYER_ENABLED set — every chain including real-DB round trips runs

envForTests: RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET (any whsec_ value; the e-mail E2E signs with it)
database.migrations: server/comm/migrations/*.sql, applied idempotently at boot and by runMigrations() in tests; additive/non-destructive only.

deploy.secretsPolicy: all secrets are Render env vars with sync:false; never committed. No secret is ever printed in logs, commits, or docs.
deploy.verifyAfterDeploy: GET /healthz returns { ok: true }; then run the quality gate against the deploy's database before calling the deploy successful.

rollback.strategy: Render keeps prior deploys; roll back by redeploying the previous successful image. Database migrations are additive/non-destructive, so a code rollback does not require a schema rollback.
rollback.notes: Never run a destructive migration or delete production data as part of a rollback.

commLayer.note: COMM_LAYER_ENABLED=1 + DATABASE_URL set and verified on ftrlabs-testerbeheer; Resend inbound MX + webhook + RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET + MAIL_API_KEY configured.

EMAIL.evidence: prod Render logs 2026-08-15: inbound stored + contact_matched=true, human-approved outbound send -> 200; retry-safe reprocessing recovered a transient MAIL_API_KEY failure.

WHATSAPP.activation: human-action (Meta account); status stays sandbox until real external E2E

SMS.activation: human-action (Twilio account); status stays sandbox until real external E2E

PHONE.provider: click_to_call (tel: URI, iPhone/Apple Continuity over KPN)
PHONE.activation: phase1 none; phase2 human-action + product decision

mayAutonomously: normal deployments when the quality gate is green
mustNotAutonomously: purchase or port a phone number
send real external messages to real people for a test without explicit permission
lower a security or privacy gate
redesign the Journey or make a major UX/brand change without a product decision
agentBoundaries.onBlockingHumanAction: record a single `HUMAN ACTION: …`, park only that item, and continue with other unblocked work.

security.webhooks: every inbound webhook is signature-authenticated and fail-closed without its secret; replay is defended by provider_message_id idempotency; media is referenced, never fetched, in the webhook path (no SSRF).
security.consent: server-side per-channel consent gate on every outbound; opt-out is first-class and always wins.
security.outbound: AI never sends; only an explicit human-approved action sends external text.
security.logging: PII-safe by construction (server/comm/obs.mjs); no personal data, content, or secrets in logs.
knownFindings: xlsx@0.18.5 (SheetJS) has a high-severity advisory with no npm fix; import path is admin-only. Documented, not silently repackaged. Revisit when a safe backwards-compatible fix exists.

externalRepos.note: runs its own quality gate; a federated gate can aggregate the --json verdicts.

writingRule: public-facing copy uses no hyphens or dashes as a stylistic device; use a period, comma, colon, or a new sentence. Technical identifiers, URLs, code, filenames and quoted external text are exempt.
